# Wheel reference restoration — Astra sketch

Read architect/SKILL.md, its Codex mapping, and design red flags. This is one panel runner's read-only sketch, not the parent orchestration or implementation.

## Grounding

CategoryWheel owns rendering and generic selected/onselect interaction; CategoryWheelOption owns caller-supplied local geometry and presentation. The same closed path drives SVG fill, focus outline, and button clip-path. rankings.ts supplies the category semantics; the gallery has its own geometry fixtures. Existing selected CSS colors the whole closed boundary and removes tint from unselected sectors, which cannot express the reference. The feature currently puts Companies bottom-left and Parties bottom-right; move whole option geometry assignments to obtain the required placement without changing IDs or rankingRows. Icon glyphs are checked exhaustively against IconName.

## Caller and minimal contract

```ts
{
  id: 'members', label: 'MPs', icon: 'group', accent: 'member',
  path: 'M138 8 A130 130 0 0 0 8 138 L78 138 A60 60 0 0 1 138 78 Z',
  rimPath: 'M138 8 A130 130 0 0 0 8 138',
  left: 0, top: 0, x: 73, y: 73
} satisfies CategoryWheelOption<RankingCategory>
```

Add required `rimPath: string` immediately after `path`. Contract: open outer boundary in exactly the same local coordinate system as the closed `path`; it must not contain inner/straight boundaries. Required field makes all callers update explicitly, including the gallery's additional option fixture. Keep existing generic IDs, closed path, coordinates, size API, and callback unchanged.

## Rendering sketch

For each option, render (1) focus-outline if focused, (2) sector surface using closed path and same translation, (3) rim using rimPath and translation. Give explicit classes to surface and rim instead of styling all paths identically. Surface always has subtle accent tint (~6–9% mixed with canvas), fine accent-muted or line stroke (~1px); selection does not brighten inner/straight boundaries. Rim always has no fill and a ~5–6px stroke; selected uses full accent, others accent mixed toward canvas (~30–40%). Tuning should be judged at feature size 220px, keeping 284 viewBox and transform scaling.

Labels and their icons always inherit sector accent, including neutral Parties. Increase icon from 20 to ~28 base pixels and label from 15 to ~17 base pixels; remove the global muted icon override for sector buttons. Center an aria-hidden bar-chart icon (~25 base pixels) at 142,142, with muted token and no pointer events. Use an explicit `.wheel-shape` selector for the outer SVG so a center SVG cannot accidentally inherit the 284px canvas dimensions. No tick, new copy, or extra interaction.

Add `flag` and `chart` (or a consistent descriptive bar-chart name) to IconName and exhaustive glyph map; reuse group/person/building. MPs top-left group; Individuals top-right person; Parties bottom-left flag; Companies bottom-right building. Keep page size220.

## Alternatives and synthesis

1. Explicit required rimPath (recommended): minimal migration, supports arbitrary caller geometry without parsing path syntax. Risk is paired geometry drifting; document their shared coordinate contract and update all fixtures together. Existing public API already delegates geometry, so this preserves ownership.
2. Replace caller geometry with a quadrant enum and internal geometry map: stronger single ownership and smaller future caller surface, derives closed/rim paths once, but narrows generic wheel to four fixed quadrants and requires deleting all path/position fields across callers. Reasonable larger redesign, unnecessary for restoring this reference.
3. CSS stroke dasharray or splitting at ` L`: reject. Dash lengths rely on path construction/direction; splitting assumes serializer syntax. Neither is a reusable exact outer-arc contract.

Verification: typecheck catches incomplete option migrations; gallery and feature interaction checks preserve aria-pressed and onselect; screenshots at desktop and actual 220px size confirm all four persistent fills, correct placement, outer-only selected highlight, neutral center, and label fit. Check keyboard focus separately since rim overdraw can partially cover the existing focus outline.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}));
